label: Exteneral
summary: Body architectures as aesthetic and functional responses to forced evolution.
description:
“The body is our general medium for having a world.”
 - Maurice Merleau-Ponty, Phenomenology of Perception

If the body is the medium through which the world is perceived, what happens when that world loses coherence?

Exteneral (combining the prefix ex- with the entomological term "teneral", describing an organism  still soft and not yet fully formed)  is an ongoing research project exploring body architectures as aesthetic and functional responses to forced evolution.

Adaptation is never innocent. A body altered for survival exists between evolution and violence, where enhancement may also be experienced as an invasion from within.

At the centre of the research lies a suspended state: the moment in which the former anatomy can no longer hold, while the next has not yet stabilised. 

Whitin this state, mutation ceases to be a deviation from the system. It becomes the system itself.
